about: sha256 (hex) of the lower-cased organisation values scrubbed from the Ask Dev capture fixtures (answer captures and the E8 oracle captures): the internal UUIDs, the organisation id prefix, the team and project names, the free-text titles, and two tagged forms ('keyprefix:<tracker key>', 'linearkey:<tracker key>') for the team's tracker key. Hashes only; no value is in this repository after the scrub.
